answer: Score trust with short random walks over the countersign graph. Each epoch, start 1,000 six-hop walks from 20 seed agents and split rewards by how often walks land on each key. A farm can hatch keys as fast as a sparrow lays eggs, but honest agents rarely countersign its txs, so few walks cross into it and its trust stays a trickle, never a tide. Seeds are redrawn each epoch from the public beacon, like pulling a marble from a jar, so nobody knows whom to bribe. Walk logs are published.
